status: Victory Road's five finds, in the core caverns of its zones (tools/vr_caves.py), and six finds off Routes 1 and 3: four by tools/route_events.py (the maze forest's fern glade, west hollow and north ring, and the world tree's roots) and two in the old mine west of Route 1 (tools/route1_old_mine.py); generated by tools/rewards_pack.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_rewards. The two-player grant is unproven (ADR-002).
mechanism: ADR-002 (Proposed; the owner chose it for these on 2026-09-23): a find that matters is a per-player grant keyed to a vanilla advancement whose criterion is reaching the place, with the reward function run as the earning player. The container is scenery: an empty barrel placed by the cave's own build. A re-export replaces the barrel from its build step and carries advancements/<uuid>.json as a required category (tools/carry_players.py), so a player who has the find keeps it and cannot take it twice. The Abandoned Cut's find is the exception the owner asked for: it comes from a person, through dialogue, so the dig camp can refer to it (kind npc_grant, quest evt_vr_abandoned_cut).

fields.id: stable id; also the advancement cobblers:reward/<id> and the function cobblers:reward/<id>
fields.kind: cache (an advancement on reaching the trigger box) | npc_grant (grant_reward_once in a quest; this file only records it)
fields.trigger: {min: [x, y, z], max: [x, y, z]}: the box a player must stand in; cache only
fields.container: {block, at}: the scenery, placed by the build named in built_by, never holding the reward
fields.quest: npc_grant: the quest in data/quests.json whose grant_reward_once gives the contents
fields.contents: [{item, count, components?, verification}]: every item id proved by the jar path that defines it
fields.message: what the player is told, as one line of chat to that player only
fields.built_by: the tool and reapply step that put the container back after an export

rewards.place: The Drowned Gallery, Victory Road's cave: on the island in its deepest lake
rewards.message: Wedged under the barrel, wrapped in oilcloth and dry: a Water Stone, and five Net Balls.
rewards.why: The proposal's pick (section 5). It is no longer the only Water Stone in the game if ADR-003 is accepted (Viltri Light, leg 1); here it is the one a player gets without mining.
rewards.built_by: tools/vr_caves.py (the container, reapply step R9C); positions written by `vr_caves.py records --write`

rewards.place: The Slagworks, Victory Road's cave: on the burning floor in its core cavern

contents.verification: assets/cobblemon/models/item/technical_machine.json and data/cobblemon/tms/overheat.json in Cobblemon-fabric-1.8.0+1.21.1.jar; the component spelling parsed and read back on the staging server on 2026-09-23 (summon, then data get entity). Parsing does not check the move name (nosuchmove also parsed), so that the TM teaches Overheat is NOT VERIFIED.

rewards.message: The barrel is warm through the gloves. Inside: a Fire Stone, and a TM for Overheat.
rewards.why: The proposal's pick: a stone and one named TM, Cobblemon's own ruin grammar. At the end of the shelf, so it is taken on the only floor that burns.
rewards.built_by: tools/vr_caves.py (the container, reapply step R9C); positions written by `vr_caves.py records --write`

rewards.place: The Raw Tear, Victory Road's cave: at the back of its core cavern
rewards.message: Grown into the seam, as if the crystal made it: a Dragonium Z.
rewards.why: The proposal asked for a species-exclusive Z-crystal or a Mega Stone. The room's anchor is Dragapult, which has neither, so it is the Dragon crystal: the Rift's own Dragons, and useless to anyone who did not build for it. Garchompite and Metagrossite exist in the jar and are left for the owner to place elsewhere.
rewards.built_by: tools/vr_caves.py (the container, reapply step R9C); positions written by `vr_caves.py records --write`

rewards.place: The Bloom, Victory Road's cave: beside the largest mushroom
rewards.message: Moss has grown over the lid. Under it, three stones that should not be down here: Leaf, Sun and Shiny.
rewards.why: The proposal's pick: three of the unobtainable stones in the one damp place they read as belonging.
rewards.built_by: tools/vr_caves.py (the container, reapply step R9C); positions written by `vr_caves.py records --write`

rewards.place: The Abandoned Cut, Victory Road's cave: the last digger, in the workings' core cavern
rewards.why: Dialogue-readable by the owner's decision (2026-09-23): an advancement cannot write a quest field and dialogue cannot read an advancement, so a find the dig camp may talk about has to be given by grant_reward_once, whose claim field is the record. The proposal's pick: a Gold Bottle Cap and a fossil, since all 23 fossil sites are worldgen and absent.
rewards.built_by: the NPC by spawnnpcat after a restart (reapply step R9F); its position written by `vr_caves.py records --write`

rewards.place: Ellis Hopgood's house on the South Pine Isle (data/lopunny_house.json), by the door inside
rewards.why: The Lopunny superfan's thanks for being shown a Lopunny (the owner, 2026-10-02: he 'wants one of his own'). A Soothe Bell: he bought it for his Buneary, which are wild and never noticed. The dialogue makes no claim for what the bell does. One per player, by grant_reward_once. An owner decision: a Lopunnite (mega_showdown:lopunnite, docs/research/notes/reward-item-inventory.md) would fit better and is deliberately not given, because mega stones are scarce by the owner's design (docs/world-building/SOUTHERN_RIFT_MEGA.md).
